name: 3 Sum
source: OA problem, ported. Bounds and input format chosen here, not read from the statement.

variables.name: n
variables.source: CHOSEN. At least 3 so a triplet can exist. 3000 admits the O(n^2) two pointer solution and excludes O(n^3), which would be 2.7*10^10.

variables.name: s
variables.source: CHOSEN. A triplet of the extreme element values sums to at most 3*10^5, so any target outside this range is trivially unreachable.

variables.name: a
variables.source: CHOSEN. Matches the usual bound on this problem, and keeps every partial sum inside int.
